argv:
A=http://127.0.0.1:18083
m1=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/wt_m1.body -w "%{http_code}" $A/readyz)
m2=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/wt_m2.body -w "%{http_code}" $A/api/v1/workspaces)
m3=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/wt_m3.body -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer tok-wt-alice" $A/api/v1/workspaces)
m4=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/wt_m4.body -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer tok-somebody-else-totally-unknown" $A/api/v1/workspaces)
echo "\"readyz\": $m1"; echo "\"no-token workspaces\": $m2"; echo "\"valid-token workspaces\": $m3"; echo "\"unknown-token workspaces\": $m4"
echo "-- m1 body:"; head -c 200 /tmp/wt_m1.body; echo
echo "-- m2 body:"; head -c 200 /tmp/wt_m2.body; echo
echo "-- m3 body:"; head -c 200 /tmp/wt_m3.body; echo
echo "-- m4 body:"; head -c 200 /tmp/wt_m4.body; echo
sanitize: DSN/password URLs scrubbed in .final copies; secret VALUES never captured in argv; env file never copied
